name: Easy Mondays
why: Elevated cotton basics built outward from a t-shirt, made in Portugal and sold through specialty shops rather than direct.
origin: Toronto, built around the pursuit of one t-shirt and named for the ease of a Monday crossword.
opview: The pitch is the opposite of newness: one t-shirt got right, then the smallest possible wardrobe around it.

onething.n: the garment the brand was built outward from. NO LINK — no US-facing own-site page was verified; the only listing reached was a Canadian stockist quoting CAD

notes.cotton: cotton carries essentially the whole range — jersey, slub and organic weights
notes.craft: made in Portugal, which is the brand's main claim above the elevated-basics field it sits in
notes.reach: Canadian, small, and reaching the US only through specialty shops

cities: No US own retail established; carried by specialty independents on both sides of the border

marks: Lycra - LICENSED (Invista fibre brand), on exactly 1 of 23 products, and ONLY as a composition line: '- 97% Cotton - 3% Lycra' on the Stretch Chino. MARKED composition_only. NOTHING ELSE: 0 TM/(R) glyphs or entities across all 23 PDPs and 90 content/collection pages
